nodes.name: run-loop.ts
nodes.summary: The agent loop — per step it filters compacted history, dispatches subtask and compaction task parts, triggers auto-compaction on overflow, resolves tools, assembles the system prompt suffix with skills/environment/instructions, streams the assistant turn, and exits when the assistant finishes without pending tool calls.
nodes.languageNotes: A ~280-line Effect.fn("SessionPrompt.run") generator with an explicit while(true) loop and a RunLoopDeps deps-object; all sibling helpers (title, getModel, handleSubtask, resolveTools, insertReminders) are imported from this directory and called with forwarded deps.

nodes.name: shell.ts
nodes.summary: User-initiated shell command execution — materializes user/assistant messages and a running shell tool part, spawns the child process with streamed output persisted into the part, finalizes abort/error states, and emits v2 sync events.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Effect.uninterruptibleMask with restore() around the spawn so setup is atomic while the wait remains interruptible; a Latch signals readiness to callers.

nodes.name: subtask.ts
nodes.summary: Handles a subtask (task-tool) step in the agent loop — materializes the assistant message and running tool part, invokes the TaskTool with the parent's merged permission ruleset, finalizes success/error/cancelled states, and appends a synthetic summary user message for command subtasks.

nodes.name: title.ts
nodes.summary: Generates a short session title from the first real user turn using the small title model via LLM.stream, stripping think tags and truncating to 100 characters.

nodes.name: tools.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves registry and MCP tools into an AI-SDK tool map for a single model turn — wiring permission asks, plugin before/after triggers, cached schema transforms, MCP content-to-attachment conversion, and output truncation through an EffectBridge-backed runner.

nodes.name: merge-options.ts
nodes.summary: Single deep-merge helper (remeda mergeDeep) with per-layer debug logging, extracted from llm.ts so the provider/model/agent/variant option-merge chain is independently testable.

nodes.name: message-continuation.ts
nodes.summary: Pure function that wraps user-message text parts arriving after the last finished assistant turn in <system-reminder> blocks so the model addresses them and continues its tasks.
nodes.languageNotes: Mutates parts in place on the passed array — callers must operate on a copy (per repo AGENTS.md).

nodes.name: message-v2.ts
nodes.summary: V2 message read/write layer — hydrates MessageTable/PartTable rows into WithParts, converts history to AI SDK model messages (media stripping, tool-output truncation), cursor-paginates history, filters compacted spans, and maps provider/AI-SDK errors to named error objects.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes Drizzle SQL (JSON extraction via `data->>'$.snapshot'` for boundary snapshots) with Effect; re-exports everything from message.schema.ts so consumers see one surface.

nodes.name: message.schema.ts
nodes.summary: Effect Schema definitions for V2 messages and parts — named schema errors (APIError, ContextOverflowError, AuthError, ...), output formats, the full Part union (text, reasoning, tool with state variants, subtask, compaction, snapshot, patch), and User/Assistant/Info schemas with zod mirrors.
nodes.languageNotes: `.zod` bridges are attached only to union schemas (Format, Part, Info), not individual members — a documented convention in the session AGENTS.md; schema types are kept in the consuming module due to Effect Schema cross-file identity issues.

nodes.name: message.ts
nodes.summary: V1 message type definitions — ToolCall/ToolResult/ToolInvocation shapes, the legacy message part union (text, reasoning, tool invocation, source URL, file, step start), and message Info, re-exporting shared named errors.

nodes.name: overflow.ts
nodes.summary: Thin async wrappers exposing ContextBudget.usable/isOverflow through the compaction service's standalone runtime.

nodes.name: plan.ts
nodes.summary: Computes the plan-file path for a session — the instance storage plans directory plus created-time and slug segments.

nodes.name: runLoop
nodes.summary: The core agent loop generator: each iteration filters compacted history, checks finish/tool-call state, forks title generation on step 1, dispatches subtask and compaction task parts, auto-compacts on overflow, resolves tools and system suffix, processes the assistant turn with structured-output handling, and applies message continuation wrapping.

nodes.name: shellImpl
nodes.summary: Executes a user shell command end-to-end: materializes user/assistant messages and a running tool part, applies plugin-provided env, spawns the child process with output streamed into the part, handles interrupt-based abort, and finalizes part and message state.

nodes.name: handleSubtask
nodes.summary: Executes a subtask via the TaskTool: materializes the assistant message and running part, merges parent agent permission with session permission for the ruleset, finalizes completed/error/cancelled states with interruption handling, and appends the synthetic summarize-and-continue user message for command subtasks.

nodes.name: title
nodes.summary: Generates and persists a session title from the first real (non-synthetic) user turn when only one exists — streams from the title agent's model (falling back to the provider's small model), strips think tags, and truncates to 100 characters.

nodes.name: resolveTools
nodes.summary: Builds the AI-SDK tool map from registry and MCP tools with cached schema transforms, a permission-wired ask/updateToolCall context, plugin before/after triggers, MCP content-to-attachment conversion, structuredContent inclusion, and output truncation.

nodes.name: mergeOptions
nodes.summary: Deep-merges a source options object into a target via remeda mergeDeep, logging which layer contributed which keys when a layer name is supplied.

nodes.name: wrapMessageContinuation
nodes.summary: Mutates message parts in place so user text parts after the last finished assistant turn are wrapped in a <system-reminder> asking the model to address them and continue — callers must pass a copy.

nodes.name: hydrate
nodes.summary: Loads parts for the given message rows from PartTable (batched inArray query) and assembles WithParts objects preserving row order.

nodes.name: toModelMessagesEffect
nodes.summary: Converts WithParts history into AI SDK ModelMessages — per-provider media support checks, tool-output truncation for compaction, synthetic attachment prompts for unsupported media, tool-state to tool-result mapping, and reasoning part handling.

nodes.name: page
nodes.summary: Cursor-paginates a session's messages in descending order (limit+1 probe), verifies the session exists, hydrates items, and returns ascending items with the next-page cursor.

nodes.name: boundarySnapshots
nodes.summary: Picks the earliest and latest snapshot/patch JSON payloads for a session by part type using SQL JSON extraction on PartTable.data.

nodes.name: messagesForSummary
nodes.summary: Loads a target message plus its child assistant messages (matched by parentID via JSON extraction) in chronological order, for summary regeneration.

nodes.name: filterCompacted
nodes.summary: Removes compacted history spans from a message list while keeping summary messages and honoring tail_start_id boundaries — the reverse-then-rescan implementation is documented as order-sensitive.

nodes.name: latest
nodes.summary: Extracts the latest user, assistant, and last-finished messages plus pending compaction/subtask task parts from a message list — the anchor state for each agent-loop iteration.

nodes.name: fromError
nodes.summary: Dispatches an unknown error through typed handlers — abort, output length, API key load, ECONNRESET, zlib decompression, invalid response, API call, and generic — producing named error objects for message persistence.
